```{r loading-data}
#| output: false
source(here::here("scripts", "paths_and_packages.R"))
p_load(see, backbone, kableExtra, DT)

# Loading Data
bert_df <- readRDS(file.path(
  data_path,
  "closest_sentences_0.01_rationality_score_filtered_with_embeddings.rds"
))
setDT(bert_df, key = "sentence_id")
bert_df <- bert_df[between(publication_year, 1900, 2019), ]

metadata <- read_rds(file.path(
  data_path,
  "full_metadata_journals_cleaned.rds"
)) %>%
  .[
    refined_sub_type == "research-article" & language == "eng",
    .(id, is_part_of, title, creator, publication_year, jstor_url = url)
  ] %>%
  .[order(publication_year)]

documents_cluster <- readRDS(file.path(
  data_path,
  "sentences_intertemporal_cluster.rds"
)) %>%
  left_join(select(bert_df, id, sentence, sentence_id, similarity)) %>%
  left_join(metadata) %>%
  arrange(sentence_id)

rm(metadata)

bert_df <- bert_df |>
  left_join(
    select(
      documents_cluster,
      sentence_id,
      backbone_community,
      window,
      kmean_cluster_id
    ),
    by = "sentence_id"
  )

backbone_network <- read_rds(file.path(
  data_path,
  "sentences_clusters_backbone_network.rds"
))

list_clusters <- documents_cluster %>%
  pull(backbone_community) %>%
  unique() |>
  sort()

results <- readRDS(file.path(data_path, "clustering_rational_sentences.rds"))
```

```{r adding-references, eval=FALSE}
# Adding references
cli::cli_alert_info("Adding references...")
nodes <- map(graphs, ~ . %N>% as_tibble()) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    value_col = if_else(is.na(value_col), dynamic_cluster_leiden, value_col),
    ID_Art = as.integer(ID_Art),
    Titre = if_else(
      !is.na(url_jstor),
      glue("<a href='{url_jstor}' target='_blank'>{Titre}</a>"),
      Titre
    )
  )

sentences_art <- documents_cluster %>% 
  count(id, window, backbone_community) %>% 
  inner_join(distinct(match_jstor_wos, id = id_jstor, ID_Art), relationship = "many-to-many")

refs <- open_dataset(
  here::here(wos_data_path, "all_ref.parquet"),
  format = "parquet"
) %>%
  filter(ID_Art %in% unique(sentences_art$ID_Art)) %>%
  select(ID_Art, ItemID_Ref, Annee, Nom, Revue_Abbrege) %>%
  collect()

top_refs <- nodes %>%
  distinct(ID_Art, value_col, time_window) %>%
  left_join(refs, by = "ID_Art", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(ItemID_Ref != 0) %>%
  group_by(value_col, time_window, ItemID_Ref) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(time_window, value_col, desc(n)) %>%
  group_by(time_window, value_col) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  left_join(
    refs %>% distinct(ItemID_Ref, Nom, Annee, Revue_Abbrege),
    by = "ItemID_Ref",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  distinct(value_col, time_window, ItemID_Ref, nb_cit = n, .keep_all = TRUE)

top_refs_without_id <- nodes %>%
  distinct(ID_Art, value_col, time_window) %>%
  left_join(refs, by = "ID_Art", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(ItemID_Ref == 0 & Annee != 0 & Nom != "") %>%
  group_by(value_col, time_window, Nom, Annee) %>%
  add_count() %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  distinct(ID_Art, value_col, time_window, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(time_window, value_col, desc(n)) %>%
  group_by(time_window, value_col) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # left_join(refs %>% distinct(ItemID_Ref, Nom, Annee, Revue_Abbrege), by = "ItemID_Ref", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  select(value_col, time_window, Nom, Annee, Revue_Abbrege, nb_cit = n) %>%
  distinct(value_col, time_window, Nom, Annee, .keep_all = TRUE)

rm(refs)
```

```{r preparing-tfidf-kmean-cluster}
# Naming clusters and tf-idf---------------------
setDT(documents_cluster)
unigrams <- documents_cluster[, .(
  sentence_id,
  sentence,
  window,
  kmean_cluster_id,
  backbone_community
)][, token := tokenizers::tokenize_words(sentence, lowercase = TRUE)][,
  -("sentence")
]
bigrams <- documents_cluster[, .(
  sentence_id,
  sentence,
  window,
  kmean_cluster_id,
  backbone_community
)][, token := tokenizers::tokenize_ngrams(sentence, n = 2, lowercase = TRUE)][,
  -("sentence")
]
tokens <- rbind(unigrams, bigrams)
tokens <- tokens[,
  .(token = unlist(token)),
  by = .(kmean_cluster_id, backbone_community, window)
]
tokens <- tokens[nchar(token) >= 2, ]
tokens <- tokens[, c("word_1", "word_2") := tstrsplit(token, " ")]

stop_words <- tidytext::stop_words$word %>%
  unique()
tokens <- tokens[
  # Remove any digits in either word
  !grepl("[0-9]", word_1) &
    (is.na(word_2) | !grepl("[0-9]", word_2)) &
    # Remove stopwords in either word
    !(word_1 %in% stop_words) &
    (is.na(word_2) | !(word_2 %in% stop_words))
]
tokens <- tokens[, .(kmean_cluster_id, backbone_community, window, token)]
tokens[, token := str_replace(token, " ", "_")]

tokens_count_kmean_cluster <- compute_tf_idf(
  tokens,
  token_col = "token",
  document_col = "kmean_cluster_id"
)
# Top tf-idf terms
top_terms_kmean_cluster <- tokens_count_kmean_cluster[order(-tf_idf)][
  absolute_tf > 20,
  head(.SD, 15),
  by = kmean_cluster_id
]

# Labels per decade
labels_kmean_cluster <- tokens_count_kmean_cluster[order(-tf_idf)][
  absolute_tf > 20,
  head(.SD, 5),
  by = kmean_cluster_id
]
labels_kmean_cluster <- labels_kmean_cluster[,
  .(label_kmean_cluster = paste0(token, collapse = ", ")),
  by = .(backbone_community, kmean_cluster_id)
]
labels_kmean_cluster[,
  label_kmean_cluster := paste0(backbone_community, "_", kmean_cluster_id, ": ", label_kmean_cluster) # we save the backbonne community number to see difference in top terms depending on kmean cluster
]

documents_cluster <- merge(
  documents_cluster,
  labels_kmean_cluster,
  all.x = TRUE,
  by = c("backbone_community", "kmean_cluster_id")
)
```

```{r preparing-tfidf}
# The strategy here is to calculate tf-idf at the window level, and then to average, to avoid giving too much weight to more recent windows.
tokens[,
  new_variable := str_c(
    backbone_community,
    window,
    sep = "--"
  )
]
tokens_count_window <- compute_tf_idf(
  tokens,
  token_col = "token",
  document_col = "new_variable"
)

tfidf_mean_community <- tokens_count_window[
  absolute_tf > 20,
  .(mean_tf_idf = mean(tf_idf)),
  by = .(token, backbone_community)
][order(-mean_tf_idf)]

# Top tf-idf terms
top_terms_cluster <- tfidf_mean_community[,
  head(.SD, 20),
  by = backbone_community
]

# Get top 4 tf-idf tokens per cluster
labels_backbone_community <- tfidf_mean_community[,
  head(.SD, 4),
  by = backbone_community
][, .(backbone_community, token)]
labels_backbone_community <- labels_backbone_community[,
  .(label_backbone_community = paste0(token, collapse = ", ")),
  by = backbone_community
]
labels_backbone_community[,
  label_backbone_community := paste0(
    str_extract(backbone_community, "\\d+$"),
    ": ",
    label_backbone_community
  )
]

documents_cluster <- merge(
  documents_cluster,
  labels_backbone_community,
  all.x = TRUE,
  by = "backbone_community"
)
```

```{r top-sentences-centroid}
# Here, we want to find the closest sentences to the centroid of the backbone communities. This implies
# calculating the centroid of each backbone community first, and then calculating cosine similarity between
# each sentenc embeddings and the centroid.

# Convert to data.table
bert_df_for_mat <- copy(bert_df)

# Expand bert_embedding_concat list into separate columns
# Assume each embedding is length 3072
bert_df_for_mat <- bert_df_for_mat[, as.data.table(do.call(rbind, embedding))]
bert_df_for_mat$backbone_community <- bert_df$backbone_community

# Calculate mean of each dimension by backbone_community
cluster_centroids <- bert_df_for_mat[,
  lapply(.SD, mean),
  by = backbone_community
]

# Ensure embedding columns are correctly selected
embedding_cols <- setdiff(names(bert_df_for_mat), "backbone_community")

# Build paragraph matrix with sentence_id as row names
# sentences_mat <- as.matrix(bert_df_for_mat[, ..embedding_cols])
# rownames(sentences_mat) <- bert_df$sentence_id

# Build centroid matrix with backbone_community as row names
centroid_mat <- as.matrix(cluster_centroids[, ..embedding_cols])
rownames(centroid_mat) <- cluster_centroids$backbone_community

# Get the list of clusters
clusters <- unique(bert_df_for_mat$backbone_community)
bert_df_for_mat$sentence_id <- bert_df$sentence_id

# Set how many top sentences you want
top_n <- 20

top_sentences_backbone_community_centroid <- map_dfr(
  clusters,
  function(cluster) {
    # Filter sentences for this cluster
    cluster_sentences <- bert_df_for_mat[backbone_community == cluster]

    # Extract the centroid for this cluster
    centroid_vec <- centroid_mat[cluster, , drop = FALSE]

    # Calculate cosine similarity
    cluster_mat <- as.matrix(cluster_sentences[, ..embedding_cols])
    rownames(cluster_mat) <- cluster_sentences$sentence_id

    sim_vec <- text2vec::sim2(
      x = cluster_mat,
      y = centroid_vec,
      method = "cosine",
      norm = "l2"
    )[, 1]

    # Get top N most similar sentences
    top_idx <- order(sim_vec, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(top_n, length(sim_vec))]

    data.table(
      backbone_community = cluster,
      sentence_id = names(sim_vec)[top_idx],
      similarity = sim_vec[top_idx],
      rank = 1:length(top_idx)
    )
  }
)
top_sentences_backbone_community_centroid[, sentence_id := as.integer(sentence_id)]

rm(bert_df, bert_df_for_mat)
```

```{r preparing-network-plot}
centroids <- map(1:length(results), ~ pluck(results, ., "centroids")) %>%
  bind_rows %>%
  mutate(cluster_original_id = 1:n())

# Calculate cosine similarity between all centroids
centroid_matrix <- centroids %>%
  select(-.cluster, -window, -cluster_original_id) %>%
  as.matrix()
cosine_sim <- lsa::cosine(t(centroid_matrix))

window_levels <- documents_cluster %>%
  pull(window) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

# Finding proximity between backbone communities based on their centroids
# extract node table from g
nodes_tbl <- backbone_network %>%
  activate("nodes") %>%
  as_tibble(.name_repair = "minimal") |>
  mutate(x = as.integer(factor(window, levels = window_levels)))

# feature columns in `centroids` (exclude meta cols)
feat_cols <- setdiff(
  names(centroids),
  c(".cluster", "window", "cluster_original_id")
)

# 2) average centroid features per intertemporal community (new_cluster)
comm_centroids <- centroids %>%
  mutate(cluster_id = 1:n()) %>%
  left_join(nodes_tbl %>% select(cluster_id, community), by = "cluster_id") %>%
  group_by(community) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(feat_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3) hierarchical clustering on scaled community-centroid matrix
mat <- comm_centroids %>% select(-community) %>% as.matrix()
mat_scaled <- scale(mat) # scale so features comparable
d <- dist(mat_scaled, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(d, method = "average")

# 4) order communities along the dendrogram
comm_levels <- comm_centroids$community[hc$order]

# 5) build a smooth palette so adjacent communities are visually similar
names(cluster_colors) <- comm_levels
```

```{r plot-network}
documents_cluster[, size_window := .N, by = window]
documents_cluster[,
  proportion_kmean_cluster := .N / size_window,
  by = kmean_cluster_id
]
backbone_network <- backbone_network %>%
  activate("nodes") %>%
  left_join(
    documents_cluster %>%
      distinct(
        cluster_id = kmean_cluster_id,
        backbone_community,
        label_kmean_cluster,
        label_backbone_community,
        proportion_kmean_cluster
      ),
    by = "cluster_id"
  )

backbone_network <- backbone_network %>%
  activate("edges") %>%
  mutate(
    community_from = .N()[["community"]][from],
    community_to = .N()[["community"]][to],
    edge_community = if_else(
      community_from == community_to,
      community_from,
      NA_character_
    ),
    edge_community = factor(edge_community, levels = comm_levels)
  )

# compute layout and community centroids
set.seed(89)
layout <- ggraph::create_layout(backbone_network, layout = "fr")

community_average <- layout %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(community) %>%
  summarize(
    x = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    layout %>% as_tibble() %>% distinct(community, label_backbone_community),
    by = "community"
  )

# plot: edges coloured by edge_community when endpoints share same community, otherwise grey
backbone_network_plot <- ggraph(layout
) +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(colour = edge_community),
    alpha = 0.6,
    width = 2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    aes(fill = community, size = proportion_kmean_cluster),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    shape = 21
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = community_average,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      label = str_wrap(label_backbone_community, 30),
      fill = community
    ),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold",
    alpha = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 3)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 25)) +
  labs(edge_width = "Avg similarity") +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = cluster_colors, na.value = "grey80") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  theme_void()

ggsave(
  here("pictures", "backbone_communities_network.png"),
  backbone_network_plot,
  units = "cm",
  width = 30,
  height = 30,
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::include_graphics(here("pictures", "backbone_communities_network.png"))
```

```{r temporal-network}
# per-window equally spaced y to avoid overlap
nodes_pos <- nodes_tbl %>%
  group_by(window) %>%
  arrange(desc(community), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    n_in_window = n(),
    y = ifelse(n_in_window == 1, 0, seq(-1, 1, length.out = n_in_window))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# distribute nodes vertically within each (community, window) cell to avoid overlap
# compute per-(community,x) offsets without calling seq() on a vector
# compute required band per community (max nodes in any x for that community)
comm_band <- nodes_pos %>%
  mutate(community = factor(community, levels = comm_levels)) %>%
  group_by(community, x) %>%
  summarise(n_in_cell = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(community) %>%
  summarise(
    max_in_column = max(n_in_cell, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(community) %>%
  mutate(
    max_in_column = pmax(max_in_column, 1L),
    pad = 0.7, # vertical padding between community bands
    band = max_in_column + pad # total vertical band height for the community
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline = cumsum(lag(band, default = 0)) + band / 2 # center y for each community band
  ) %>%
  select(community, band, baseline)

# assign nodes within their community/x band
nodes_pos <- nodes_pos %>%
  mutate(community = factor(community, levels = comm_levels)) %>%
  left_join(comm_band, by = "community") %>%
  group_by(community, x) %>%
  arrange(window, cluster_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    n_in_cell = n(),
    # centered offsets inside the community band; works for n_in_cell == 1 as well
    offset = (row_number() - 0.5) * band / n_in_cell - band / 2,
    y = baseline + offset
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cluster_id, x, y, community)

# join positions into the graph nodes (match keys exactly)
temporal_backbone_network <- backbone_network %>%
  activate("nodes") %>%
  left_join(nodes_pos, by = c("cluster_id", "community"))

# compute label positions for communities (uses comm_band and layout from above)
community_label_positions <- comm_band %>%
  left_join(
    layout %>% as_tibble() %>% distinct(community, label_backbone_community),
    by = "community"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(community, comm_levels)) %>%
  mutate(label = str_wrap(label_backbone_community, 40))

temporal_network_plot <- ggraph(
  temporal_backbone_network,
  layout = "manual",
  x = x,
  y = y
) +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(colour = edge_community),
    alpha = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    width = 2
  ) +
  geom_label(
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = cluster_id, fill = community, size = proportion_kmean_cluster),
    label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines"),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = cluster_colors, na.value = "grey80") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(window_levels),
    labels = window_levels
  ) +
  # y axis showing community labels at their baseline positions
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = community_label_positions$baseline,
    labels = community_label_positions$label,
    expand = expansion(add = c(1, 0.8))
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 1),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "grey50"),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "grey50"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "grey50"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "grey50"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  here("pictures", "temporal_network_plot.png"),
  temporal_network_plot,
  units = "cm",
  width = 30,
  height = 30,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r interactive-temporal-network}
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "grey50"),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "grey50"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "grey50"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "grey50"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 9)
  )

# create interactive girafe object with sensible hover/tooltip styling
girafe_obj_time <- ggiraph::girafe(
  ggobj = temporal_network_ggiraph_plot,
  width_svg = 16,
  height_svg = 10,
  options = list(
    ggiraph::opts_selection(type = "single"),
    opts_tooltip(use_fill = TRUE),
    ggiraph::opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 12), # wheel to zoom, drag to pan
    ggiraph::opts_toolbar(position = "topright")
  )
)
```

```{r template}
#| results: 'asis'

for (cluster in list_clusters) {
  cluster_data <- documents_cluster %>%
    filter(backbone_community == !!cluster) %>%
    mutate(title = glue("<a href='{jstor_url}' target='_blank'>{title}</a>"))
  cluster_name <- cluster_data %>%
    pull(label_backbone_community) %>%
    unique

  # extracting the first year and last year of the community
  window <- c(
    first(unique(cluster_data$window)) %>% str_extract("^\\d{4}"),
    last(unique(cluster_data$window)) %>% str_extract("\\d{4}$")
  )

  ################ Beginning of the template ######################
  cat(sprintf("  \n## Intertemporal cluster _%s_ \n\n", cluster_name))

  ############# General Info ##################
  cat(paste0(
    "  \nThe cluster gathers ",
    length(unique(cluster_data$sentence_id)),
    " sentences from our corpus. It represents ",
    round(
      length(unique(cluster_data$sentence_id)) /
        length(unique(documents_cluster$sentence_id)) *
        100,
      2
    ),
    "% of all the sentences selected over the whole period.\n"
  ))

  cat(paste0(
    "\nThe community exists from ",
    window[1],
    " to ",
    window[2],
    ". \n\n"
  ))

  recurring_authors <- cluster_data %>%
    select(creator, id) %>%
    unnest(creator) %>%
    add_count(creator, name = "nb_sentences") %>%
    distinct(creator, id, nb_sentences) %>%
    add_count(creator, name = "nb_articles") %>%
    distinct(creator, nb_sentences, nb_articles) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = nb_sentences, n = 10)
  cat(paste0(
    "The most recurring authors are ",
    paste0(
      recurring_authors$creator,
      " (",
      recurring_authors$nb_sentences,
      " sentences; ",
      recurring_authors$nb_articles,
      " articles)",
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    ".\n\n"
  ))

  recurring_journals <- cluster_data %>%
    select(is_part_of, id) %>%
    add_count(is_part_of, name = "nb_sentences") %>%
    distinct(is_part_of, id, nb_sentences) %>%
    add_count(is_part_of, name = "nb_articles") %>%
    distinct(is_part_of, nb_sentences, nb_articles) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = nb_sentences, n = 5)
  cat(paste0(
    "The most recurring journals are ",
    paste0(
      recurring_journals$is_part_of,
      " (",
      recurring_journals$nb_sentences,
      " sentences; ",
      recurring_journals$nb_articles,
      " articles)",
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    ".\n\n"
  ))

  ############# TF-IDF ##################
  cat("\n### Top TF-IDF terms describing the community\n\n")
  # Extracting top terms in general and for window
  top_terms_cluster %>%
    filter(backbone_community == !!cluster) %>%
    select(token, mean_tf_idf) %>%
    kbl(col.names = c("Token", "TF-IDF")) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
      font_size = 15
    ) %>%
    print()

  if (length(unique(cluster_data$window)) > 1) {
    cat(
      "\n### Top TF-IDF terms describing the different k-means clusters\n\n"
    )

    for (kmean in unique(cluster_data$kmean_cluster_id)) {
      cat(
        glue(
          "#### Top terms {cluster_data[kmean_cluster_id == kmean,]$label_kmean_cluster |> unique()} ({cluster_data[kmean_cluster_id == kmean,]$window |> unique()})\n\n"
        ),
        sep = ""
      )

      top_terms_kmean_cluster %>%
        filter(kmean_cluster_id == kmean) %>%
        select(token, tf_idf) %>%
        kbl(col.names = c("Token", "TF-IDF")) %>%
        kable_styling(
          bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
          font_size = 11
        ) %>%
        print()
    }
  }

  ############# Distribution sentences ##################
  cat("\n### Distribution of sentences over time \n\n")

  plot(
    cluster_data %>%
      count(publication_year) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = publication_year, y = n)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0), n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
      theme_light(base_size = 20) +
      labs(y = "Number of sentences", x = NULL, title = NULL)
  )

  ####### Top Sentences ###################
  top_sentences_rationality_filtered <- top_sentences_rationality %>%
    filter(backbone_community == !!cluster) %>%
    left_join(select(
      cluster_data,
      title,
      is_part_of,
      creator,
      jstor_url,
      sentence_id
    )) %>%
    mutate(title = glue("<a href='{jstor_url}' target='_blank'>{title}</a>"))

  top_sentences_kmean_cluster_centroid_filtered <- top_sentences_kmean_cluster_centroid %>%
    filter(backbone_community == !!cluster) %>%
    left_join(
      select(
        cluster_data,
        title,
        is_part_of,
        creator,
        sentence_id,
        jstor_url
      ),
      by = "sentence_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(title = glue("<a href='{jstor_url}' target='_blank'>{title}</a>"))

  top_sentences_backbone_community_centroid_filtered <- top_sentences_backbone_community_centroid %>%
    filter(backbone_community == !!cluster) %>%
    left_join(
      select(
        cluster_data,
        title,
        publication_year,
        is_part_of,
        creator,
        sentence_id,
        sentence,
        jstor_url
      ),
      by = "sentence_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(title = glue("<a href='{jstor_url}' target='_blank'>{title}</a>"))

  ############# Top sentences rationality ##################
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(
    "\n### Closest sentence from 'rational' and 'rationality' of the backbone community\n\n"
  )

  top_sentences_rationality_filtered %>%
    slice_max(similarity, n = 20, by = backbone_community) %>%
    select(
      sentence,
      title,
      publication_year,
      is_part_of,
      creator,
      similarity
    ) %>%
    kbl(
      escape = FALSE,
      col.names = c(
        "Sentence",
        "Title",
        "Year",
        "Journal",
        "Authors",
        "Words Similarity"
      )
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
      font_size = 12
    ) %>%
    column_spec(2, "3.5cm") %>%
    print()

  ############# Top sentences centroid ##################
  cat("\n### Closest sentences of the backbone community's centroid\n\n")

  top_sentences_backbone_community_centroid_filtered %>%
    slice_max(similarity, n = 15) %>%
    select(
      sentence,
      title,
      publication_year,
      is_part_of,
      creator,
      similarity
    ) %>%
    kbl(
      escape = FALSE,
      col.names = c(
        "Sentence",
        "Title",
        "Year",
        "Journal",
        "Authors",
        "Centroid Similarity"
      )
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
      font_size = 13
    ) %>%
    column_spec(2, "3.5cm") %>%
    print()

  if (length(unique(cluster_data$kmean_cluster_id)) > 1) {
    cat(
      "\n### Closest sentences of each kmean cluster's centroid composing the backbone community\n\n"
    )

    for (kmean in unique(cluster_data$kmean_cluster_id)) {
      cat(
        glue(
          "#### Top terms {cluster_data[kmean_cluster_id == kmean,]$label_kmean_cluster |> unique()} ({cluster_data[kmean_cluster_id == kmean,]$window |> unique()})\n\n"
        ),
        sep = ""
      )

      top_sentences_kmean_cluster_centroid_filtered %>%
        filter(kmean_cluster_id == !!kmean) %>%
        slice_min(distance_to_centroid, n = 5) %>%
        select(
          sentence,
          title,
          publication_year,
          is_part_of,
          creator,
          distance_to_centroid
        ) %>%
        kbl(
          escape = FALSE,
          col.names = c(
            "Sentence",
            "Title",
            "Year",
            "Journal",
            "Authors",
            "Distance to Centroid"
          )
        ) %>%
        kable_styling(
          bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
          font_size = 12
        ) %>%
        column_spec(2, "3.5cm") %>%
        print()
    }
  }

  ############# Top articles ##################
  cat("\n### Top articles (most sentences) of the backbone cluster\n\n")
  # Extracting top terms in general and for window
  cluster_data %>%
    mutate(
      mean_similarity = mean(similarity) %>% round(3),
      n = n(),
      .by = id
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      title,
      publication_year,
      is_part_of,
      creator,
      n,
      mean_similarity
    ) %>%
    slice_max(n, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    kbl(
      escape = FALSE,
      col.names = c(
        "Title",
        "Year",
        "Journal",
        "Authors",
        "Number sentences",
        "Similarity"
      )
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
      font_size = 13
    ) %>%
    print()

  if (length(unique(cluster_data$kmean_cluster_id)) > 1) {
    cat(
      "\n### Top articles (most sentences) of the cluster for each time window{.panel-tabset}\n\n"
    )

    for (kmean in unique(cluster_data$kmean_cluster_id)) {
      cat(
        glue(
          "#### Top articles for {cluster_data[kmean_cluster_id == kmean,]$label_kmean_cluster |> unique()} ({cluster_data[kmean_cluster_id == kmean,]$window |> unique()})\n\n"
        ),
        sep = ""
      )

      cluster_data %>%
        filter(kmean_cluster_id == !!kmean) %>%
        mutate(
          mean_similarity = mean(similarity) %>% round(3),
          n = n(),
          .by = id
        ) %>%
        distinct(
          title,
          publication_year,
          is_part_of,
          creator,
          n,
          mean_similarity
        ) %>%
        slice_max(n, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
        kbl(
          escape = FALSE,
          col.names = c(
            "Title",
            "Year",
            "Journal",
            "Authors",
            "Number sentences",
            "Similarity"
          )
        ) %>%
        kable_styling(
          bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
          font_size = 13
        ) %>%
        print()
    }
  }
}
```
